metadata.title: A Reilly-Type Inequality for CR Dirac Operators on CR Manifolds and Applications
metadata.abstract: The first two authors derived the Weitzenböck-type Formula for a CR Dirac operator. In this paper, we apply the above-mentioned formula and follow the process as Riemannian case to derive a Reilly-type inequality. We give two applications for the CR Reilly inequality. One is a lower bound estimate of the p-mass in terms of the first eigenvalue of the modified hypersurface CR Dirac operator. Another one is to solve the CR Dirac equation on a bounded domain with an $S^{1}$-action and an APS-type boundary condition.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: CR Dirac 算子的 Reilly 型不等式
analysis.workSummary: 从 CR Dirac 的 Weitzenböck 型公式导出 Reilly 型不等式，用于以修正边界 CR Dirac 首特征值估计 p-mass，并求解带 S¹ 作用及 APS 型边界条件的有界域 CR Dirac 方程。
analysis.breakthrough: 把 Riemannian 自旋方法推进到 CR 质量及边值问题。
analysis.limitations: 两个应用分别需要相应边界几何与 S¹ 作用条件；摘要未给出精确常数及全部边界假设。
analysis.priorityReason: 把 Riemannian 自旋方法推进到 CR 质量及边值问题。
